items.title: UnitedHealth’s Policy Change Opens a New Chapter for its Insurance Business
items.summary: UnitedHealthcare, the insurance business of UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (NYSE:UNH), will remove prior authorization requirements for a broad range of healthcare services beginning October 1. The changes will cover areas including cardiology, genetic and laboratory testing, chiropractic care, physical, occupational and speech therapy, and orthopedic and musculoskeletal procedures.
